          "description": "\nVolunteers will support CAFB’s mobile meals program, where we serve hot meals to kids on our renovated school bus. The bus will stop at two neighborhood sites in Fairfax County, where volunteers will help with serving meals and leading activities for children, such as worksheets, arts and crafts, and games. The locations we serve at are:  \n\n\n\n\n\t\n\n\t\nAudubon Estates  \n\n\t\n\n\n\n\n\n4:00–5:30 pm  \n\n\n\n7930 Audubon Ave, Alexandria, VA 22306  \n\n\n\n(outside the leasing office)  \n\n\n\n\n\t\n\n\t\nLorton Community Action Center  \n\n\t\n\n\n\n\n\n6:00–7:30 pm \n\n\n\n9520 Richmond Hwy, Lorton, VA 22079 \n\n\n\n(in the parking lot) \n\n\n\nVolunteers should arrive outside the Audubon Estates leasing office at 3:50 PM, and wait for the bus to arrive and park in front of the center. After Audubon’s meal time is complete, volunteers will follow behind the bus to Lorton Community Action Center to support their meal service. This opportunity will take place outside so volunteers should dress accordingly to the weather and wear closed-toe shoes. The opportunity also takes place around children so all clothing should be age appropriate.  \n\n\n\n \n\nCourt-ordered hours are NOT ACCEPTED for this opportunity. \n",
